_comment: Per-model prices, per million tokens, with the date each was taken from the vendor's
published list. A model with no entry here raises UnpricedModel rather than being costed
with someone else's rates: the ledger's accuracy is the only cost control this phase has,
and a wrong price does not fail, it quietly mis-states the running total.
Adding a model is a line here. Nothing in the code needs to change.
